profile.headline: Experienced Java & Spring Boot Engineer | AWS | Distributed Systems & Cloud Solutions
profile.summary:
* 18+ years of extensive development experience in Java technology. 
* Experience of design and development from scratch as well maintaining the complex applications and in depth understanding of SDLC.
* Architect and Design Lead experience.
* Deployment experience on different platforms like Window, Linux.
* Application development experience for Manufacturing Industry, Product Configurators, Transactional Applications.
* Experience of design and development of real time, high throughput-low latency distributed systems.
* Hands on development experience in Core Java, Spring, Spring Boot,  multithreading, data structures and algorithms. 
* Hands on experience on AWS, like EC2, Security, RDS, S3, CloudFront, CloudFormation, VPCs, Elastic Beanstalk.
* Expert level understanding of JVM memory model. Hands on development experience using java concurrency APIs.
* Hands on development experience using J2EE technologies like Servlet, JSP, JDBC and Web Services.
* Expertise in designing and developing using XML technologies, different kind of parsers SAX/DOM/StAX and binding frameworks like JAXB, XML Beans etc.
* Hands on experience of using GoF design patterns and following object oriented design principles like SOLID. 
* Web Services based on SOA.
* Expert on RDBMS concepts. Experience of using SQL Server, MySQL, Hands on experience MongoDB.
* Understanding of the UML design diagrams.
* Excellent analytical and problem solving skills. 
* Able to handle complex requirements independently.
* Experience of mentoring, leading and managing team of 2-9 technical team members and end to end delivery responsibility.
* Expertise in coordinating diverse teams and resources to complete objectives.
* Understanding of Android and Objective C.
* Understanding on Ruby development and deployments.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
. Software Development using JAVA, Spring, Spring boot, Rest Easy.
. Managing deployment through AWS
. In depth knowledge of Spring Integration Mail, MongoDB, GraphQL
. Expertise in developing solutions around different e-commerce domains and Event management domains.
. Exclusive knowledge of Microsoft CRM integration.
positions.insights: Skills: Core Java · Java · Reverse Engineering · Servlets · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Software Development · Web Services · Software Project Management · Spring Framework · Spring Boot · Magnolia CMS · Java Web Services · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Java Tech Lead
positions.description:
•	Implement and maintain development best practices.
•	Lead team of 9 resources. (.net team and Java Team)
•	Oversee multiple projects across all phases of development.
•	Monitor workflow and make timeline adjustments as needed.
•	Work as part of an interdisciplinary team to achieve project milestones.
•	Collaborate with development to plan project sprints.
•	Develop status reports and resource plans.
•	Make vital decisions and drive decision-making across projects.
•	Software Development as and when needed. (Java, Hibernate, JSP, Servlet)
•	Review the source code and manage Sub Version Control

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Managed resource and capacity planning for projects.
•	Converted Desktop Application to Web-Based Application in 2 months.
•	Software Development and co-ordination between team members. (Java, Hibernate, JSP, Servlet)
•	Supported development and software quality assurance to ensure optimal progress and product stability for end users.
•	Trained team members on development processes & review the source code.
•	Coordinated with customer to gather requirements and manage expectations.
Set and adjusted project milestones.
•	Successfully delivered the Mobile Application development projects for Android and Objective C.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer

•	Engineered customized features and modules for new applications using JAVA SWING
•	Devised enhancements and updates for existing application suites. 
•	Conducted detailed testing throughout life cycle and resolved system issues.
